_help: Which tile numbers belong to which release. Ranges like "1-19" or lists like "20,21,25-30". Leave empty if unknown. Release ids: is = Immortal Souls, ap = Arcane Portal, df = Darkness Falls, vl = Vastaryous' Lair (Immortal Souls saga); ac = Ancient Chronicles, nt = Northwind Tales; mota = Myths of the Arena; al = Abyssal Legends; custom. Then re-run: .venv/bin/python scripts/extract_quest_editor.py
